stem: A utility lets customers contact support only by phone. Which change removes a barrier for customers who are Deaf or hard of hearing?

options.rationale: A text-based channel lets customers who cannot use a phone get the same service.

options.text: Extend the phone line's opening hours.
options.rationale: Longer hours do not help someone who cannot communicate by voice.

options.text: Add a voice menu with more options.
options.rationale: A longer voice menu is still an audio-only channel.
Hold volume does not make the service usable by text.

explanation: A phone-only service excludes people who cannot hear or speak on the phone. Email or chat gives them an equivalent way to reach support. Longer hours, more voice options, and louder audio all keep the service in the same audio-only channel.
author: Oxypteros
